import os,re,json
def load():
    d=os.path.normpath(os.environ['RLM_SESSION_DIR'])
    t=open(d+'/../../sessions/'+os.path.basename(d)+'.jsonl').read().replace('\\n','\n'); G={}
    for m in re.finditer(r'(Demo pair \d+ (?:input|output)|Test input) \((\d+)x(\d+)\):\n',t):
        k,h,w=m[1],int(m[2]),int(m[3])
        rows=[r.split() for r in t[m.end():].split('\n')[:h]]
        if k not in G and all(len(r)==w and all(x.isdigit() for x in r) for r in rows):
            G[k]=[[int(x) for x in r] for r in rows]
    return G
G=load()
def f(g):
    g=[r[:] for r in g]; Hh,Ww=len(g),len(g[0])
    rows=[r for r in range(Hh) if sum(x==3 for x in g[r])>2]
    cols=[c for c in range(Ww) if sum(g[r][c]==3 for r in range(Hh))>2]
    r0,r1=min(rows),max(rows); c0,c1=min(cols),max(cols)
    o=[r[:] for r in g]
    # find inner 3s strictly inside box
    pts=[(r,c) for r in range(r0+1,r1) for c in range(c0+1,c1) if g[r][c]==3]
    anchor = pts[0] if pts else ((r0+r1)/2,(c0+c1)/2)
    ar,ac=anchor
    for r in range(r0+1,r1):
        for c in range(c0+1,c1):
            if g[r][c]!=3:
                k=max(abs(r-ar),abs(c-ac)) if pts else min(max(abs(r-r0-0.5),abs(c-c0-0.5)),max(abs(r-r1+0.5),abs(c-c1+0.5)))
                o[r][c]= 4 if k%2==1 else 2
    return o
for n in ('1','2','3'):
    print(n, f(G[f'Demo pair {n} input'])==G[f'Demo pair {n} output'])
res=f(G['Test input'])
print(json.dumps(res))
